title: Some Remarks about Integral Categories
author: Yaroslav Kopylov, Max Zinchenko
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's prop (sa-int2) (source0.tex lines 208-212, source label sa-int2). The statement reads: prop sa-int2 A right semi-abelian category A is right integral if and only if pushouts of monomorphisms along epimorphisms in A are monomorphisms. Dually, a left semi-abelian category A is left integral if and only if pullbacks of epimorphisms along monomorphi.
